task: CH-05A Jev adapter and pure routing
comparison: Working tree and untracked new modules against baseline; HEAD equalled baseline at review start

closed_findings.title: Alternating provider privacy wrappers recursively grow the global log record factory
closed_findings.symptom: 600 alternating main/Jev privacy installations cause RecursionError for an ordinary application Logger.makeRecord call; affects all logging in the process.
closed_findings.resolution: Both wrappers use functools.wraps(previous), preserving earlier privacy markers while retaining independent ContextVar isolation and avoiding cross-provider imports.
closed_findings.independent_verification: Same standalone probe: 600 alternating pairs, ordinary logger, both provider private contexts and outside context pass.

reviewed_boundaries.conclusion: One domain DTO vocabulary, immutable snapshots, validation only, no transport or authorization actions; missing usage remains unknown.
Pure advice restricted to registered allowed choices; explicit choice remains authoritative; no mutation, DB, environment, provider switching or permission grant.
Independent fixed wire projection and strict parsing; scope is hashed locally, not sent; fixed errors and no raw-body logging.

Independent, disconnected adapter; default disabled/no_egress before secret and HTTP import; existing lazy httpx2, fixed endpoint, no automatic retry/proxy/redirect, preserved cancellation and config checks.

architecture_groups: Disabled and no-egress skips precede secret and HTTP import
Three-field pure routing preserves input and allowed set

limitations: Only .local review artifacts were written; no product, author test, project status or commit changes by reviewer.
No real secret, customer material or remote model use.
No repeat of codec/provider full suite or Windows frozen acceptance; these are separately owned.
This is a Standards review, not Spec replacement, production authorization, persistent budget integration or Chinese legal-quality validation.
